name: Internship: Software Engineering
job_description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Internship: Software Engineering. 

 

The hourly rate for this position is $22.15 - $37.50 per hour.

 

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. 

What you’ll do:

Do you want to gain enriching experiences and work side by side with experienced engineers to power your career? Apply to our Software Engineering Internship! 

Over the course of this twelve-week paid internship based at the Plymouth, MN site (about 10 miles west of Minneapolis), you will gain a firm grasp of our core engineering competencies and a holistic view of our technology-driven solutions that serve our wide range of customers.
